headline_marked: Mirza Fakhrul's [[MP and minister posts to be vacated]] upon presidential oath
headline: Mirza Fakhrul's MP and minister posts to be vacated upon presidential oath
summary: Chief Whip Nurul Islam Moni stated that Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will cease to be an MP and minister once he takes the oath as President.
details: Government Chief Whip Nurul Islam Moni announced that Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, the MP for Thakurgaon-1, will vacate his parliamentary and ministerial positions immediately upon taking the oath of office as President.

Speaking at a press briefing at the National Parliament building on Thursday, August 20, Moni explained that once the oath is taken, the individual will no longer be an MP or a minister, but will become the President of Bangladesh.
Following this transition, a by-election will be held to fill the vacant seat in the Thakurgaon-1 constituency.
Regarding the voting process, the Chief Whip clarified that current acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad will also cast his vote in the presidential election since he is a member of Parliament.
Additionally, Moni addressed queries regarding the voting status of Jamaat-e-Islami MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, stating that his party would be able to provide clarity on that matter.
caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir will lose his MP and ministerial seats the moment he becomes President.

Government Chief Whip Nurul Islam Moni announced that Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, the MP for Thakurgaon-1, will vacate his parliamentary and ministerial positions immediately upon taking the oath of office as President.

Speaking at a press briefing at the National Parliament building on Thursday, August 20, Moni explained that once the oath is taken, the individual will no longer be an MP or a minister, but will become the President of Bangladesh.

Following this transition, a by-election will be held to fill the vacant seat in the Thakurgaon-1 constituency.

Regarding the voting process, the Chief Whip clarified that current acting President Hafiz Uddin Ahmad will also cast his vote in the presidential election since he is a member of Parliament.

Additionally, Moni addressed queries regarding the voting status of Jamaat-e-Islami MP Gazi Nazrul Islam, stating that his party would be able to provide clarity on that matter.

#Bangladesh #PresidentialElection #Politics #Dhaka #NationalParliament

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Somoy News
